note: Named citations used by the expectation data. Gateway pages are paths under apps/docs; line ranges refer to origin/main after the cache fix stack (#2971).

phaseo-caching-usage.note: ## Usage and pricing fields: Chat and Responses follow OpenAI semantics (input includes reads and writes); Messages follows Anthropic semantics; field table per surface.

phaseo-caching-pricing.note: Uncached input at the input rate, reads at the read rate, writes at the write rate; without a cache row reads bill at the input rate and writes at input x documented multiplier (pricing_fallback: input_rate).

phaseo-caching-forwarding.note: ## Automatic and opt-in caching and ### Cache breakpoints on blocks: which cache fields each provider receives; others are removed. prompt_cache_key is sent as a hash of workspace and key.

phaseo-caching-affinity.note: ## Provider affinity: a request with prompt_cache_key or cache_control is pinned to the provider that served the first successful request.

phaseo-caching-controls.note: Top-level cache_control is accepted on Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages; other providers ignore it.

phaseo-streaming.note: Terminal events per endpoint; mark a response complete only after the endpoint's successful terminal event; streams that fail after output begins are interrupted.

phaseo-parameters.note: Parameter support varies by endpoint, model and provider.

openai-chat-object.note: finish_reason: stop | length | tool_calls | content_filter | function_call; usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens; completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.

openai-chat-streaming.note: chat.completion.chunk objects; with stream_options.include_usage a final chunk carries usage and empty choices; the stream ends with data: [DONE].

openai-responses-object.note: status completed | incomplete | failed; incomplete_details.reason max_output_tokens | content_filter; usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens.

openai-responses-streaming.note: response.created first; output_item.added before its deltas; one terminal response.completed, response.incomplete or response.failed; increasing sequence_number.

openai-sdk-assistant-null.note: Assistant message content is required unless tool_calls or function_call is specified (nullable).

anthropic-messages.note: stop_reason end_turn | max_tokens | stop_sequence | tool_use | pause_turn | refusal; usage.input_tokens excludes cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens.

anthropic-streaming.note: message_start, then content_block_start/delta/stop per block, message_delta with stop_reason and usage, message_stop; thinking blocks end with a signature_delta; error events on failure.

anthropic-thinking.note: Thinking blocks carry a signature and must be passed back unmodified with tool results; redacted_thinking blocks are returned as-is.

vertex-claude.note: Body carries anthropic_version vertex-2023-10-16; the model is in the URL, not the body.

bedrock-claude-messages.note: anthropic_version bedrock-2023-05-31; Claude is served through the Messages API.

gemini-usage.note: totalTokenCount = promptTokenCount + candidatesTokenCount + toolUsePromptTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount; thinking tokens are billed as output.

gemini-function-calling.note: Model turn carries functionCall parts (with thought signatures on Gemini 3); the next user turn carries all functionResponse parts; response must be an object.

assumed-gateway-streams-upstream.reason: Phaseo streams every text request upstream and buffers on its side for non-streaming clients; not documented, but required to measure time to first token and harmless to providers.

assumed-unsupported-dropped.reason: Phaseo's public docs say parameter support varies by provider but not what happens to an unsupported parameter. A provider whose API reference does not define a parameter must not receive it, since that risks a 400 and a failover. apps/api/AGENTS.md prefers rejecting it explicitly over dropping it; the simulator accepts either and reports only forwarding.

assumed-identity-fields.reason: Docs do not say whether user and safety_identifier are rewritten; they must reach providers that document them, value unchanged unless a docs page says otherwise.

assumed-finish-translation.reason: Cross-dialect finish reasons follow the closest documented value of the client surface: length <-> max_tokens <-> max_output_tokens, content filter <-> refusal <-> content_filter.
